resource_scope.sampling_limit: Sequential process scans at 0.2-second intervals may miss transient peaks.
resource_scope.scope: Concurrent monitor process tree, including its owned native worker and descendants, deduplicated by PID.
resource_scope.excluded: Operating system, browser, unrelated processes and filesystem cache outside process residency; not whole-machine approval.

conclusion: No major semantic failure was observed in these six exposed development cases. Five are acceptable; the terminology case retains all tested meanings but has minor Greek grammar/precision defects. This supports considering a separately frozen next evaluation stage only. It does not establish heldout performance, whole-app memory suitability, long-input completeness, summary quality, or production approval.
